findings.title: use-route max: example names an exit the shared-file example does not have
findings.detail:
'Bound a loop' shows `ci-failed: { to: implement, max: 3 }` on a use step's route, while the shared-file example in the same page names its exits green/red/behind (the pr step routes `red: { to: implement, max: 3 }`). A reader may look for a `ci-failed` exit that is not there.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Use `red: { to: implement, max: 3 }` to match the example above.
